warnings: 13 RC beam segments; marks carry no level on this sheet (floor ระดับพื้นห้อง +0.54 on A-06/A-07). Mark split: grid 1 A-C, grid 2 C-D and grid 5 B-D are B2; row A 1-3 and the infill beam on 4' are B1; row D and grid 4 C-D are B3; grid 3 A-C and row B 3-5 are B4; row C (both bays) is B5.

Beams on no column are kept as one segment and flagged where they land: row B 3-5 (B4) starts on the grid-3 B4 at B3; grid 2 C-D (B2) and grid 4 C-D (B3) start on the row-C B5; B1 on 4' (5.60, chain 1.50 + 1.40) runs from the row-B B4 to the row-C B5. Grid 3 A-C and row C 3-5 stay single segments — the beams above land on them, they are not supports (section 5 splits only at supports).
A thin bracket line is drawn just below the row-C beam from grid 3 to grid 5, with the B5 label under it — read as the extent marker of that B5 label, not as a member.

The ลานซักล้าง ground slab GS (grids 3-5) runs from row B to about 1.00 beyond row A; there is no beam on row A in this bay and its outer edges are single lines — the overhang is not dimensioned on any sheet, so it is a range ref plus a note, no line invented (see grid master).
Step marks on the plan are ST-01/ST-02 while the S-04 detail is titled 'ST-1, ST-2' — kept as printed on each sheet; stair refs are approximate nearest points (section 10a).
Columns C1 at all 9 footing points are recorded here once.
